summaryQuote: “The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.”
emptyHint: Keep logging your worship in the trackers and your badges will appear here

detail.unlockedOn: Unlocked on {date}. May Allah accept it from you

prayer: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَّوْقُوتًا
quran: “Read the Quran, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.”
dhikr: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
fasting: “Whoever fasts a day for the sake of Allah, Allah keeps his face seventy autumns away from the Fire.”
nawafil: “My servant keeps drawing near to Me with voluntary deeds until I love him.”
knowledge: “Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.”
journal: وَقُلِ اعْمَلُوا فَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ
